content:
How can I obtain a list of Lean’s nightly releases?
Is there an official convenient API?
Does https://release.lean-lang.org/ help? That format can be considered stable
Thank you. I think this is helpful

What's the latest nightly release? I want to get some updates that were made on June 3. I tried
leanprover/lean4:nightly-2026-06-03 and some other dates, and lake seems to try to install but then comes back with revision not found.

@Bjørn Kjos-Hanssen, I'm a bit mystified here. Could you run elan self update and try again? Could you point to a repo that is experiencing this problem / provide us with instructions to reproduce the error you are seeing?
Not sure of the details, but that date stands out to me as one we skipped over in CSLib nightly testing because of that toolchain not existing on Mathlib nightly testing.
@Kim Morrison thanks---I don't have the problem anymore since v4.31.0-rc2 was released. But maybe the next person to have a similar problem will find this thread and we can pick it up then.
